title: Pairs Divisible by Seven
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Count pairs i < j with (a_i + a_j) divisible by 7.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5; 0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9 (the large test gives
a_i = i·i mod 1 000 000 003).

Residual counting: c[r]·c[7−r] plus C(c[0], 2).

tests.name: residual mix
n=200000 deterministic
tests.hint: Ground truth via residual counts computed in Python: [31061, 30931, 33580, 23862, 30962, 25650, 23954] → 2823440748.
